texts.facts: In this case, a detailed accident report was filed by police official concerned and in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act, same is treated as claim petition u/s 166 (1) r/w 166 (4) MV Act. 2. On 23.10.2020, information regarding present accident was recorded through DD entry no. 21A whereupon concerned police officials reached Kalindi Kunj, Jaitpur Road where they found motorcycle no. DL 3SCB 2254 and motorcycle no. DL 5SEP 0200 in accidental condition. They also came to know that injured person was already removed to hospital. Thereafter, on receipt of DD no. 29A, police officials reached Apollo Hospital and obtained the MLC of injured. The police officials found eye witness /wife of the injured at the hospital itself and they recorded her statement wherein she stated that she along with her husband were coming from Iqbal Faizi Hospital, Jamia Nagar on motorcycle bearing no. DL 3SCB 2254. At about 01.15 pm, when they reached near Jaitpur, one motorcycle bearing no. DL 5SEP 0200, driven by its driver in rash and negligent manner, came from front side and hit against her motorcycle. Due to which her husband fell down on the road and sustained serious injury. He also got unconscious on the spot due to the said accident. She further hired an auto and removed her husband to the hospital. FIR in question was registered. During investigation, it was found that the said offending vehicle was driven without driving license. Further driver such offending vehicle was a CCL. Upon completion of investigation, a charge sheet was filed against R-2/ owner of the MACT No.167/2020 Bashar Khan Vs. CCL Mohit 2/24 rpt offending vehicle for offence punishable u/s 279/ 338 IPC, 3/181, 5/180 MV Act in the court of Ld. Ilaka MM whereas DAR was also filed by IO in this Court. 3. On the very first date, R-1 & 2 proposed for settlement with the claimant. Upon joint request, matter was sent to Mediation Center for 06.03.2020. However, the mediation proceedings failed and matter was proceeded further. 4. Vide order dated 10.02.2022, WS along with affidavit of income/ assets filed on behalf of registered owner Hemant Upadhyay. In a nutshell, he denied any liability to pay compensation. It is stated that his vehicle was parked in his house and CCL Mohit, who was his neigbour, took his motorcycle without permission. 5. Insurance company raised an issue that policy does not cover the date of accident. Perusal of record, it was found that the accident occurred on 27.01.2018 whereas the police issued for the period 26.02.2018 to 25.02.2019. As such, Insurance Company M/s New India Assurance Company was directed to be deleted from the array of parties vide order dated 16.02.2021. 6. Following issues were framed on 16.02.2021: 1. Whether the injured suffered injuries in a road traffic Bashar Khan(Dar) vs Ccl Mohit (34/18, Jp) on 3 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107774598/ 2 accident on 27.09.2018 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle bearing no. DL 5SEP 0200 being driven by R-1 & owned by R-2? OPP 2. OPP 3. Relief. 7. Petitioner/injured stepped in the witness box as PW1 and tendered his examination in chief by way of affidavit Ex.PW1/A. He relied upon various documents Ex.PW1/1 to Ex.PW1/6 including MLC, discharge summary, original medical documents, copy of MACT No.167/2020 Bashar Khan Vs. CCL Mohit 3/24 rpt Aadhar Card. He was not cross examined on behalf of R-1 & 2. 8. PE was closed vide order dated 13.09.2022, 9. As vehicle was without insurance, R-2/ Registered Owner was directed to furnish sufficient security amount to the tune of Rs. 2 lakhs vide order dated 17.11.2022.
